angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,102,787 km at 29.44 pc = 0.5 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 33.9667 +/- 0.0792 mas (same row, RUWE 1.14): 29.44 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.585 (1.553 to 1.617) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 1,102,787 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.482 (1.442 to 1.522) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 7094 +/- 4.5 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1677302170674242560: teff_gspphot 7094.3647 K (16th-84th percentiles 7089.9614-7099.009), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1677302170674242560: teff_gspphot 7094.3647 K (16th-84th percentiles 7089.9614-7099.009), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)

ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1677302170674242560, flags_flame 00: age_flame 1.084537 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 0.7764921 to 1.3922509)
